notes: Single-stage: debug an unknown quantity (sediment depth) reachable only through a monotone prefix oracle with two endpoints, under a hard 28-call budget, so exponential bracketing plus binary search is required and a linear scan fails. Exercises C-d6eae9b8 (binary-search a prefix oracle under a strict call budget) at easy: the verifier independently recomputes the true depth, replays every logged probe against the instrument for consistency, enforces calls<=budget and both-endpoint usage. Small nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth (bracketing+search), debugging_ambiguity (unknown L, derived property), interaction_statefulness (probe transcript must match reality), hidden_case_generalization and quantitative_correctness.
